AIRE New York · Tribeca ®

ENJOY A RENEWED SPACE

Set inside a restored 1883 textile factory, AIRE resides in Manhattan’s most cinematic and cobblestone-clad quarters and stands as one of our largest locations with 16,000 square feet of candlelit calm. Original brick, beams, and iron columns frame our thermal baths, which now feature a unique Tepidarium with a skylight where the sky itself becomes part of the experience, warm marble beds, and new massage rooms. As the first AIRE destination outside Europe, it blends historical architectural charm with the ritual of water to create a richly immersive, sensorial experience. Perfect for those seeking tranquility, more space and an iconic downtown setting.

AIRE New York · Upper East Side ®

DISCOVER OUR NEWEST LOCATION

Tucked away in a neighborhood filled with historical landmarks and world-renowned museums, this AIRE oasis is nestled in a 120-year-old historic building that once served as an art and silver collections warehouse for the Museum of Modern Art (MoMA). With over 10,000 square feet of curated space, this exclusive sanctuary of relaxation offers an intimate and elevated experience designed for true disconnection. Vaulted ceilings and loft-style architecture create a serene backdrop for its signature suspended Flotarium, a saltwater bath that appears to float mid-air. Ideal for those seeking a quiet and artful retreat in the heart of the Upper East Sid
